description: Source-backed benchmark and ordinal tier records copied from the raw Wout catalog before CMU runtime calibration.

benchmarkEvidence.note: Community reference, not a controlled research norm. Machine leverage, pulley ratio, setup and range of motion affect the load; compare progress on the same machine with consistent technique. Do not treat the percentile as an exact rank across machines. Use the seated two-leg variation; lying and single-leg curls are different exercises.

Community reference, not a controlled research norm. Machine leverage, pulley ratio, setup and range of motion affect the load; compare progress on the same machine with consistent technique. Do not treat the percentile as an exact rank across machines. Machine Row is a separate reference from Seated Cable Row. The source does not standardize every machine model or per-arm loading convention; keep your logging convention consistent.

Dedicated Strength Level dumbbell Romanian deadlift standards. Pounds per dumbbell, not the combined pair. Published bodyweight tables for men and women; 48,206 qualifying results from 287,451 community lifts, with a data cutoff of 2026-03-05.

records.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Row
records.loadNote: Combined lb including both 12 lb arms. Example: 70 lb plates per side = 164 lb total. Enter the total once.

benchmarkTier.note: Provisional iso-lateral family tiers, not validated Hammer Strength IL-ROW norms or population percentiles. The source does not disclose a model-specific sample or define per-arm vs combined loading. Wout assumes combined resistance including both workarms; this convention is an assumption, not a verified conversion. Compare records on the same machine, grip, seat setting and range of motion.
